title: 'You' badge and row keep a gold outline
steps: Open Thursday Whist Standings as Maya
expected: Status badges outline, neutral (RULINGS visual-designer-1 lists 'You')
actual: 'You' badge border rgba(253,216,53,0.7) and the 'You' row has a gold border; 'Leading' is neutral
why_it_matters: Gold is meant for the primary action/brand/active tab only
suggested_fix: Use the neutral outline badge for 'You'; drop the gold row border or make it neutral

title: Player-name links on a scored round are narrower than 44px
why_it_matters: Short names are hard to hit; the round rows are the only route to a player's page here
suggested_fix: Make the whole row the link, or give the name link a min-width/hit area

title: Open session with no scored round: figures labelled with another session of the same date
steps: Start another session the same day and a round (bidding)
expected: Clear which night the small figure is (switch, or a label that cannot be confused with tonight)
actual: 'SESSION IN PROGRESS ערב…' card above 'Total score · Thursday, 19 Nov' — the previous closed session, same date; no Tonight/Last night switch until a round is scored
why_it_matters: Reads as tonight's result when it is not
suggested_fix: Show the switch as soon as a session is open (Tonight empty: 'no rounds yet'), or prefix 'Last night:'

title: Dashed 'Trump' marker text touches its box
steps: Look at the unmarked Trump buttons
expected: Label with padding inside the dashed 44x44 box
actual: 'Trump' fills the 44px box edge to edge (scrollWidth 42 of 44, padding 0); letters touch the dashed border, box sits against the row edge
suggested_fix: Widen the box or use a smaller label/glyph

title: Round page of a 5-player session does not say who sat out
expected: A line naming the player who sat out
actual: Four rows only (Rachel, נועה, Maya, Dan); Omer not mentioned

title: After leaving a group, Back shows the other group's Players list without notice
steps: As Dan open Players > own page > Leave this group > Leave group
expected: Redirect with the 'not in its group' notice, or stay on Groups
actual: Lands on /profile showing OLD CREW ARCHIVED Players; a further Back gives the clean notice
why_it_matters: Briefly confusing context switch; no error
suggested_fix: Replace history on leave, or redirect /profile to Groups when the group changed

title: Whole averages drop the decimal

why_it_matters: Small inconsistency against the 'one decimal' ruling
evidence: look: '450 behind · 4 wins · +11 avg', '#4 יוסי … -10 avg'
